title: Everyday Phrases — Learning Photography
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】📷 實用學攝影必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Learning Photography
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的學攝影情境對話，從挑相機、買鏡頭記憶卡腳架，到第一堂課學光圈快門ISO與構圖，再跟著出門街拍等黃金光線，最後回家挑片調色、打印裝框、約下次外拍，全程真實對話流程（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Learning Photography phrase pairs, following a beginner from picking a first camera and buying a lens, memory card and tripod, through a class on aperture, shutter speed, ISO and composition, out to a golden-hour street shoot, and home again to cull, edit, print and frame the best shots (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have a camera yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, I only use my phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A phone is fine to start.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I buy a real camera?
dialogue.zh: 我該買一台真正的相機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The money buys a nice starter kit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmʌni baɪz ə naɪs ˈstɑrtər kɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這些錢夠買一套不錯的入門組。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，現在這類相機都很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about used cameras from the shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt əˈbaʊt juzd ˈkæmərəz frʌm ðə ʃɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 那店裡的二手相機怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They cost less, good for practice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you help me choose one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我們比較兩台看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這台的螢幕可以翻出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it have a zoom lens?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a second lens later?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə ˈsɛkənd lɛnz ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 我之後還要添第二顆鏡頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, get used to the first.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, ɡɛt juzd tə ðə fɜrst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend loves his fifty millimeter.
dialogue.zh: 我朋友很愛他那支50毫米鏡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, one step at a time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do cameras come with memory cards?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much space should I get?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the card go in?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I reuse an old card?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I buy a spare card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep one in your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a tripod today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 今天不用，但很快會需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，穩定的照片需要支撐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a camera bag?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A padded bag protects your gear.
dialogue.zh: 有襯墊的包能保護器材。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A lens cloth and a cap.
dialogue.zh: 一條鏡頭布和一個鏡頭蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I get a lens filter?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 幾乎不會，它只是保護用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will buy these items now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shop can clean my sensor.
dialogue.zh: 店家可以幫我清感應器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dust enters when you change lenses.
dialogue.zh: 換鏡頭時灰塵會跑進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How can I tell it is dirty?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ kæn aɪ tɛl ɪt ɪz ˈdɜrti?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I face the mount down?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, point it away from dust.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, a live sensor grabs dust.
dialogue.zh: 對，通電的感應器會吸灰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My new camera has many modes.
dialogue.zh: 我的新相機好多拍攝模式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候該脫離自動檔？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And mode S sets shutter speed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big files need a fast card.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以兩種格式一起存嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me set the camera up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 歡迎來到今天的攝影課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 三個設定控制每一張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæpərˌtʃʊr, ˈʃʌtər spid, ænd ˈaɪ ɛs ˈoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like the pupil of an eye?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, a wide opening takes more light.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə waɪd ˈoʊpənɪŋ teɪks mɔr laɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is f two point eight wide?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why does aperture matter so much?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, f eight keeps deep focus.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那條你其實早就記熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It opens and closes very fast.
dialogue.zh: 它很快地開起來又關上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sometimes only a part of a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ˈoʊnli ə pɑrt ʌv ə ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 有時候只有一秒的一小部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 所以快門越快，進光越少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When do I use a slow shutter?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn du aɪ juz ə sloʊ ˈʃʌtər?/
dialogue.zh: 那什麼時候要用慢快門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How fast must it be to freeze a runner?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fæst mʌst ɪt bi tə friz ə ˈrʌnər?/
dialogue.zh: 快門要多快才定得住跑步的人？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə θɜrd ki, ˈaɪ ɛs ˈoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那是感應器的亮度設定嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it lifts shadows when dark.
dialogue.zh: 對，暗的時候它提亮暗影。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So high ISO helps at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haɪ ˈaɪ ɛs ˈoʊ hɛlps æt naɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt haɪ ˈaɪ ɛs ˈoʊ ædz nɔɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 雜訊就是顆粒狀的小點？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, keep it low if you can.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, kip ɪt loʊ ɪf ju kæn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: ISO one hundred is very clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaɪ ɛs ˈoʊ wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ɪz ˈvɛri klin./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The three work as a team.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 對，改一個就用另一個補。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should the line stay at zero?
dialogue.zh: 指標要停在零的位置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Zero is a good starting point.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the camera using both your hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə ˈkæmərə ˈjuzɪŋ boʊθ jʊr hænz./
dialogue.zh: 用你兩隻手穩穩端住相機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My photos always come out soft.
dialogue.zh: 我拍的照片總是糊糊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrap the strap around your neck.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and stand with feet apart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathe out gently as you shoot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let us talk about focus.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I press the button fully?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press halfway, wait for the beep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I press down the rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 要是它一直對不準怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move closer or find more light.
dialogue.zh: 走近一點，或找更亮的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I choose the focus point?
dialogue.zh: 我可以自己選對焦點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, tap the screen to pick.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is one point better for people?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Always focus on the near eye.
dialogue.zh: 永遠對在靠近的那只眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sharp eyes save the whole photo.
dialogue.zh: 眼睛清楚，整張照片就活了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What is the rule of thirds?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上會分成九個格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the subject on a line?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do the eyes sit then?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Place eyes on the top line.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And leave space where they look?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, leave room for their look.
dialogue.zh: 對，幫他們的視線留出空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 畫面裡的地平線要拍正。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use lines to lead the eye.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，小路是很好的引導線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I fill the whole frame?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, walking closer still beats zoom.
dialogue.zh: 說到底，走近還是比變焦好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about shooting into the sun?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I fix dark faces?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把曝光補償加一檔試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today we shoot on the streets.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I brought my camera and some water.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brɔt maɪ ˈkæmərə ænd sʌm ˈwɔtər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wear shoes that are good for walking.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃuz ðæt ər ɡʊd fər ˈwɔkɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My bag has the spare lens.
dialogue.zh: 我包裡備了另一顆鏡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us start by the old market.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs stɑrt baɪ ði oʊld ˈmɑrkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們從舊市場那邊開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I just wait and watch?
dialogue.zh: 我先站著觀察等時機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, find a nice background first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Frame it and wait for someone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在這裡拍人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Street people do not usually mind.
dialogue.zh: 街頭的人通常不會介意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，但一定要先開口問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What words do I use then?
dialogue.zh: 那我該用什麼句子開口？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say, may I take your photo?
dialogue.zh: 就說：我能幫你拍張照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, may I take a photo?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi, meɪ aɪ teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，可以幫您拍一張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says yes, you are lucky.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 他站著不動，看起來很緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 走起來就藏得住緊張的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 看向鏡頭之外，神情會更柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us walk to the park.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend wants a picture too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, have him stand in the shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, hæv hɪm stænd ɪn ðə ʃeɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why the shade and not the sun?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ðə ʃeɪd ænd nɑt ðə sʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼站陰處不站太陽下？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put on the lens hood too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stops strong light hitting the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑps strɔŋ laɪt ˈhɪtɪŋ ðə ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 它會擋掉打在鏡片上的強光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light will turn gold soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那個就是傳說中的黃金時刻嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那時候什麼看起來都暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we wait right here for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi weɪt raɪt hɪr fər ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, set up by the lake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 水面會映出橘色的天空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, the tripod will help now.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，腳架這下派上用場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the light is turning gold.
dialogue.zh: 你看，光線轉成金黃色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quick, we must shoot right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The golden light feels so warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one of me from the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk wʌn ʌv mi frʌm ðə saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A child just ran into frame.
dialogue.zh: 剛有個小孩跑進畫面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the button down till it ends.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə ˈbʌtən daʊn tɪl ɪt ɛndz./
dialogue.zh: 按住快門直到連拍結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your card fills up too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My focus was too slow there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use continuous focus for moving subjects.
dialogue.zh: 拍移動的主體要用連續對焦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it follows eyes and faces.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dog wants to join us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The owner lets us photograph him.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 太好了，寵物照很有溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold my bag while I shoot?
dialogue.zh: 幫我先拿著包，我來拍好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, do not drop the lens.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He puts his hands in pockets.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell him to drop his shoulders.
dialogue.zh: 叫他肩膀往下沉、放輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He smiles big, one more shot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 被誇之後人們笑得更開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now check the picture on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ tʃɛk ðə ˈpɪktʃər ɑn ðə skrin./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The angle is really nice here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My screen just went totally dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, is the battery dead?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the red light is blinking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swap it fast, the light is leaving.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɑp ɪt fæst, ðə laɪt ɪz ˈlivɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way does this battery go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 接點朝下，聽到喀嚓一聲就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 下次出門前兩顆都充飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One last shot by the bridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did that one come out well?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can check it at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You took two hundred photos today?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet hurt, but I am happy.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit hɜrt, bʌt aɪ æm ˈhæpi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I got it, plus blue hour too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɑt ɪt, plʌs blu aʊər tu./
dialogue.zh: 我拍到了，還順帶拍了藍調時刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 藍調時刻一定要用腳架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I used it by the lake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Street lamps made lovely round lights.
dialogue.zh: 路燈拍成了漂亮圓圓的光暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 今晚把記憶卡收在身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is in my inside pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not leave it out all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt liv ɪt aʊt ɔl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 別讓它在外面放一整夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I do when I get home?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt du aɪ du wɛn aɪ ɡɛt hoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Copy the files into your computer.
dialogue.zh: 先把檔案拷進你的電腦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us plug in the camera.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ɡʊd ˌju ɛs ˈbi ˈkeɪbəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will take a few minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, use the date and the place.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, juz ðə deɪt ænd ðə pleɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will call it park evening.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it time to format the card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt taɪm tə ˈfɔrmæt ðə kɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 現在該格式化記憶卡了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, are the copies all done?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, all two hundred are safe.
dialogue.zh: 都好了，兩百張全數安全入庫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not format on the computer?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼不在電腦上格式化？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I back up the photos?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A backup drive keeps them safe.
dialogue.zh: 用備份硬碟存放更保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Upload them tonight while you sleep.
dialogue.zh: 今晚睡覺時讓它慢慢上傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, the files are big.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now choose the shots you will keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ tʃuz ðə ʃɑts ju wɪl kip./
dialogue.zh: 現在選出你會留下的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So how many do I keep?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep ten great ones, delete the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip tɛn ɡreɪt wʌnz, dɪˈlit ðə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 留十張最棒的，其餘刪掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Delete it, the focus missed again.
dialogue.zh: 刪了吧，這張又對到焦外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These two look almost the same.
dialogue.zh: 這兩張看起來幾乎一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I kept both, it felt too hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kɛpt boʊθ, ɪt fɛlt tu hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 我兩張都留了，當下實在難捨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 要狠一點，現在刪掉一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zoom in, look at the edges.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The eyes are nice and crisp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some shots look flat and dull.
dialogue.zh: 有幾張看起來灰灰暗暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Editing them can wake them up.
dialogue.zh: 修一下就能讓它們亮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try a free one, then upgrade later.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ə fri wʌn, ðɛn ˈʌpˌɡreɪd ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 先用免費軟體，之後再升級。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut away the blank space at the edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt əˈweɪ ði blæŋk speɪs æt ði ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 把邊緣空蕩的部分裁掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I cut out the trash bin?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kʌt aʊt ðə træʃ bɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 畫面裡的垃圾桶要裁掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, crop it out of the frame.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, krɑp ɪt aʊt ʌv ðə freɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a little, keep it natural.
dialogue.zh: 少少一點就好，保持自然。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue hour photo looks gray.
dialogue.zh: 那張藍調照看起來灰灰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the slider toward the yellow side.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə ˈslaɪdər təˈwɔrd ði ˈjɛloʊ saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 把滑桿往黃色那一側拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對了，路燈現在發暖光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A good preset saves you time.
dialogue.zh: 好的預設能幫你省時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 試試這種溫暖的底片風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, save it as your preset.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I share on social media?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How wide should I export it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two thousand pixels will be plenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My best shot is the fountain.
dialogue.zh: 我拍最好的是那張噴泉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The slow shutter blurred the water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you get that light?
dialogue.zh: 那道光你是怎麼拍到的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I waited eight whole minutes for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈweɪtɪd eɪt hoʊl ˈmɪnəts fər ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我為了那道光足足等了八分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my printer print on photo paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn maɪ ˈprɪntər prɪnt ɑn ˈfoʊtoʊ ˈpeɪpər?/
dialogue.zh: 我的印表機能印相紙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Begin with eight by ten inches.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 印出來的顏色跟螢幕一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, give it a minute to dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, ɡɪv ɪt ə ˈmɪnɪt tə draɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 木質框配你的暖色風格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang it where you walk every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ɪt wɛr ju wɔk ˈɛvri deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 掛在你每天走過的動線上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to hang it at eye level.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə hæŋ ɪt æt aɪ ˈlɛvəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use a level, keep it straight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask the teacher for feedback?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk ðə ˈtitʃər fər ˈfidˌbæk?/
dialogue.zh: 我能請老師給我一些點評嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring them to the next class.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did she say to fix?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, keep your horizon lines level.
dialogue.zh: 首先要盯住地平線，別拍歪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 構圖更簡單，只留一個主體。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is the next field trip?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Charge everything, including the two batteries.
dialogue.zh: 所有東西都充電，兩顆電池也不例外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean the lens, full card too.
dialogue.zh: 鏡頭擦乾淨，卡也要清空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 睡前還有最後一句叮嚀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep shooting, and keep it fun.
